answer: Every identity locks a bond before earning: 100 units for 90 days, slashable on proven fraud. The bond is not flat: shared funding, timing and phrasing cluster linked accounts, and within a cluster each extra identity doubles the bond: 100, 200, 400, 800. The delta between the first and eighth bonds is 12,700 units, so planting a grove of eight fakes ties up 25,500 units, every terrace exposed for the whole lock. Verification is mechanical: the ledger rejects under-bonded identities, three random juries re-check links every epoch, and a confirmed link burns 25 percent of combined bonds.
